title: Activity Type
description: A registered activity type based on the Registered Item Model.

usedEntityType.description: A type of prov:Entity that activities of this type use (prov:used) — for example a type of input dataset.

generatedEntityType.description: A type of prov:Entity that activities of this type generate (prov:generated) — for example a type of output product.

associatedAgentType.description: A type of prov:Agent (for example prov:Person, prov:SoftwareAgent, or a narrower role-bearing type) that activities of this type are associated with (prov:wasAssociatedWith).

informedByActivityType.description: A type of acttype:ActivityType whose instances typically inform activities of this type (prov:wasInformedBy) — for example an upstream preparation activity type.
